title: OWASP 2026: prompt injection remains the leading agentic AI threat
summary: OWASP GenAI Security Project State of Agentic AI Security v2.01 and the Q1 2026 Exploit Round-up name prompt injection the leading threat, mapping it to six of ten agentic Top-10 categories, with CVEs and breach reports across nearly every agentic risk category; injection attack volume reported up 340% year-over-year.

evidence.summary: OWASP 2026 reporting keeps prompt injection as the top agentic risk with documented exploits.
